g500.mechanic: Move the eye to control who moves: crescent moths move only while hidden from it, and suns only while visible. Rings show every puppet that Z will advance one step around its loop; puppets can pass their targets. W/S move the eye left/right, A switches its row, and clicks open or close hanging curtains; fixed reed screens cannot be moved. Finish with every puppet on its white corner-marked outline, the eye at its gold brackets, and later requirements met. You may win on the last bead; running out first loses. Eye moves, curtain changes and successful rewinds cost one bead each. A pulse costs one if it changes a puppet, the saved rewind point or a curtain mark; inputs that change nothing are free. D undoes only the last pulse's puppet changes, preserving the eye, curtains, curtain marks and spent beads. An empty rewind costs no bead but adds a strike; two strikes lose. Later levels require landing on marked split moon/sun points, which switch a puppet's shape and movement rule. Toggle each marked curtain and keep it changed until it changes which puppets a pulse advances; its ring becomes a crossed diamond, and it must finish in its printed OPEN or SHUT pose. A large D blocks other controls until you rewind; this is that level's only successful rewind. Reset starts over.
g500.controls: W/Up and S/Down move the eye; A/Left switches its row; D/Right rewinds the last pulse; Z or Space pulses; click a curtain to toggle it. U is the website Undo; Reset retries.
g500.goal: Move the pink crescent moth to its white corner-marked outline with the eye at its gold brackets, within five beads. The fixed reed screen hides the moth; its ring means Z moves it one step around its loop, even past its target. Eye moves and successful rewinds cost one bead; pulses do too if they move the moth or change its saved rewind point. Unchanged inputs are free, and winning on the last bead counts. D undoes the last pulse's moth changes without refunding beads; empty rewinds cost no bead but add strikes, two strikes lose, and Reset starts over.

g502.mechanic:
The numbered spots around the ring are nodes. Each shows its current number on the left and its target on the right; a check mark means they match. Up/W moves the main cyan lens one node counterclockwise and Down/S one node clockwise around the closed ring. Nodes held by a lens stay still. Press Z for Flow: only the yellow-ringed nodes change. The sign above each node shows its change: + adds one and - subtracts one. Adding to 3 wraps to 0; subtracting from 0 wraps to 3. Match every target and return the main lens to the pink home ring at the top, then click anywhere to check and advance to the next level. Clear all eight levels to win.

From Level 3, Left/A switches the lens between holding just its center node and holding that node plus its two immediate neighbors. The first and last nodes are neighbors. From Level 5, crescent-shaped nodes normally subtract one while the other nodes add one. From Level 6, Right/D reverses all plus and minus changes; pressing it again restores them. Level 6 also adds gates below some nodes: triangle gates open first, then crescent gates, alternating after every Flow, even if no numbers change. The sun or crescent at the upper left shows the current gate phase. Closed gates keep their nodes still; ungated nodes can change in either phase unless a lens holds them. Moving, resizing, and reversing do not switch the gate phase. From Level 7, a second pink lens stays two nodes clockwise from the main lens and moves with it. Left/A changes both lenses' size together; either lens can hold a node still. Only the main lens must return home for a check.

LEFT shows actions remaining. Each lens move, size change, reversal, Flow, and successful check uses one action. Size and reversal controls have no effect before they unlock and cost nothing. An incorrect check costs no action but adds one to BAD; two incorrect checks lose. You also lose if you use the last action without a successful check. Use Reset to restart and retry.
g502.controls: W/Up and S/Down move the lens around the ring; A/Left resizes it when unlocked; D/Right reverses flow when unlocked; Z or Space flows; X or CLICK checks the targets. U is the website Undo; Reset retries.
g502.goal: Match the left and right numbers at every spot on the ring; the cyan lens holds one number still. Up/W moves the lens counterclockwise, Down/S clockwise; Z (Flow) adds one to yellow-ringed spots, wrapping 3 to 0. Return the lens to the pink home ring, then click anywhere to check. Each move, Flow, and successful check uses one action from LEFT; you lose by spending the last action without passing or by making two wrong checks. Wrong checks cost no action; use Reset to retry.

g519.mechanic: You move a small black diamond with a yellow center between possible signal places, select triangle survey stations, scan, and click anywhere to commit a fix. A black ring shows the selected station; Level 1 uses yellow rays for the next allowed station, and a used station turns gray with three bars. In later free-choice levels, selecting a station previews the exact possible signal places that station would leave before you scan, so you can avoid a useless choice. A scan spends one blue stone only when it removes places; repeats, decoys, and scans that remove nothing spend no stone or action. Spend all stones, leave one large purple-ringed place, move the cursor there until green corners appear, then commit. Bottom trail marks show the action budget; if it empties before a correct fix, you lose. A wrong fix marks one of two pitons red, a second wrong fix loses, and Reset retries. Later levels add extra stations, climb-cost readings, ridge-blocked sight, a two-press station move, and signal drift after scans.
g519.controls: W/Up and S/Down move the fix cursor; A/Left selects a station; D/Right scans; Z or Space moves a station when available; X or CLICK commits the fix. U is the website Undo; Reset retries.
g519.goal: Black ring marks the selected triangle, yellow rays mark the next allowed station, and a used station turns gray with three bars. Use Select until the ring and rays meet, then Scan; a blue stone disappears, contour rays cross ruled-out places, and the choices shrink. After both stones are gone, large purple rings mark the survivor; move the small yellow-centered black diamond using the hollow or solid magenta trail mark. Green corners mean the cursor is ready, so click anywhere to commit. A wrong fix marks a red strike, a second loses, bottom marks show actions left, and Reset retries.

g542.mechanic: Before clamping, Up/Down moves the gold outline among four shapes, Left/A punches that shape into the gold empty slot, and Right/D removes the last editable punch. Level 1's riveted brass first shape is a locked example, not an empty slot, and the needed shape begins selected. Complete the bottom row to match the shown row, then press Z to clamp it. After clamping, Up/Down chooses a cam, Left/A shows its complete result, and clicking the lit green platen replays the whole row into the current page. Press Z whenever a large diamond page break blocks the next page. Later cams can keep, reverse, shift every shape, or change only the last shape; later starting ribbons may be reopened and repaired. Every accepted useful move spends one side rivet, while a blocked move or rejected audit does not; trying another useful move with none left loses. A rejected clamp or replay cracks one wax seal, and the second rejection loses. Right/D can also hide a preview or reopen an unused clamp, and Reset restarts the level.
g542.controls: W/Up and S/Down choose a shape or cam; A/Left punches or previews; D/Right removes or reopens; Z or Space clamps or advances at a page break; X or CLICK replays. U is the website Undo; Reset retries.
g542.goal: Level 1 starts with a riveted brass circle as a locked example; fill only the gold dotted slot, whose needed diamond begins selected. Press Left/A to punch it; Up/Down changes selection, green around the new punch means the bottom row matches the shown row, and Right/D removes only editable punches. Press Z to clamp, Left/A to preview, then click the lit green platen to replay the whole row into a page. At the large gold diamond, press Z before previewing and replaying again; filling both pages wins. Side rivets count useful moves, a second rejected clamp or replay loses, and Reset retries.
